shipped.title: omacom/omacut · Drop videos onto the window (#21), shipped in v0.7.0
shipped.summary: PR #21 was reworked for multi-clip timelines, merged upstream, and released minutes later in Omacut v0.7.0, which also credits the aarch64 package build from #22.
bullets: Dropping into an empty window opens the video
Dropping onto an open edit adds the files after the clip under the playhead, undoably
Only plain local files are accepted; files that won’t open are skipped with a notice
The PKGBUILD now builds for aarch64 too
shipped.quote: Thanks, this is the better of the two drop PRs!
